transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... I guess I'm just having some trouble at home. In my little studio. I... I keep hearing voices. 

It's... they're as clear as somebody standing right next to me. Just saying my name, and... telling me my work is being judged. But the house is quiet. There's nobody else there. So... that's why I came in.
Have you ever had experiences where you saw, heard, or felt things that others don't, or believed something strongly that others around you didn't seem to understand?

I guess... sometimes. People just don't get it when I try to explain. 

Like... a while back, I just got it in my head about the other home-care agency in town. Them and... some folks from the library. I just knew they were watching me. Watching my paintings, and looking at my client papers. They were trying to steal a chance that was supposed to be mine. 

People kept telling me it made no sense, but... I knew what they were doing. I don't really want to talk about them, though. That's just... what happened.

Can you tell me more about times when you felt like others were watching you or trying to interfere with your life? How often does this happen, and does it seem to be related to how you're feeling emotionally at the time?

I don't know... it's hard to say how often. 

I guess... well, there was a time when I finally stopped feeling so wound up. My energy dropped back down, and I was actually sleeping like a normal person again. But... it didn't stop. The voices, I mean. And that feeling that they were tracking my work and judging me. 

Even when I wasn't feeling all over the place emotionally... it just kept going. For a few weeks, at least. That's... all I really remember about it.
Have you had any periods where you felt down, depressed, or hopeless for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks in a row?
No... I don't really get like that. I mean... maybe just tired from work sometimes, but... no. Not depressed like you're saying. I don't think so.
Have you noticed any difficulties taking care of yourself, keeping up with your work, or getting along with others because of these experiences?

I guess... things got a bit hard to manage. 

I was missing shifts at my aide job... getting the care notes all mixed up. I just couldn't keep my visits straight anymore. They said my job was in danger. 

And... I just stayed home mostly. I stopped going to my walking club, and... I didn't go to the library art talks anymore either. Just... stayed by myself.
Have you ever had a period where you felt so down, empty, or hopeless that it was hard to function for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?
I thought... didn't you just ask me that? Like I said before... no. I don't get down or empty like that. Just... tired from work sometimes. That's it.
Have you ever experienced a time when you felt a loss of pleasure in activities you usually enjoy, or found it hard to feel anything positive, even when good things happened?

No... I don't think so. I still like things fine. 

I know I said I stopped going to my club and the library, but... it wasn't because I couldn't enjoy them. I just... didn't want to go out. 

So... no. I don't have that problem.
Have you ever had a period of time when you felt unusually energetic, needed less sleep, or felt like your thoughts were racing, where others might have noticed a change in your behavior?

Well... sometimes, I guess. 

There are nights where I just... I don't know, I get a lot done. I'll clean the whole kitchen, start working on three different paintings, crochet half a blanket... I even tried to rewrite the care schedules for work. All in one night. 

I just... couldn't sit down. Had too much energy, I suppose.
Can you tell me if there were times when your thoughts were going so fast you couldn’t keep up, or when you were so energetic that you felt like you didn’t need to sleep?

Well... I guess so. Sometimes. 

Like... my mind just won't stop. I'll be thinking about a client's medicine, and then suddenly I'm worrying about rent, and then I'm trying to come up with a title for a painting, and then... I don't know, trying to figure out some message in a song on the radio. It all just goes so fast. I can't really slow it down to make sense of any of it. 

So... yes, I suppose.

Were there times when your thoughts were so fast that other people noticed you were talking more quickly or jumping from topic to topic, or when you felt so full of energy that others thought you were acting unusually wired or out of control?

I... suppose people might have noticed. 

Sometimes I just... I get this feeling. Like everything is just so bright, and I'm... chosen for something. Like all my plans are just too big for Greenville, you know? 

But then... I don't know, it shifts. I'll get so short with people. Like if a client asks me to repeat myself, I just... snap at them. Hard. It's just... a lot of back and forth, I guess.

Have you ever had a period lasting several days or more where you felt extremely energetic, talkative, or needed very little sleep, and others might have said you were acting out of control or not yourself?

I suppose... yes. There are times like that. 

I'll go... I don't know, maybe a few days, a week... sleeping just two or three hours a night. But I don't feel tired. I'll wake up feeling... charged, I guess. Like I had a full night's rest. 

Then I just... get up and go right back to my paintings, or start making phone calls. It just... happens sometimes.
When you were not feeling unusually energetic or wired, did you still have the experiences of hearing voices or believing that others were watching or trying to interfere with you?

Yes... I think so. 

Even when the energy kind of... faded away, and I started sleeping normally again... those other things didn't stop. 

The voices kept going. And that feeling... that people were watching me, tracking what I was doing with my work, judging it... that lasted for a few weeks after I calmed down. It just... stayed with me.
During the times when you weren't feeling unusually energetic or down, did the voices or the belief that others were watching you continue without any connection to how you were feeling emotionally?

I... yes. Like I said before. 

When the energy dropped... and I was sleeping more normally again... those things just kept going. For several weeks, I guess. The voices, and... the feeling that people were tracking my work, judging it. 

It didn't seem to matter that I wasn't... wired anymore. It just kept happening.
Have you had times when your ability to function at work, take care of yourself, or interact with others was clearly worse, even when you weren't feeling unusually energetic or down emotionally?

I guess... yes, things got harder. 

I missed some shifts at my job as an aide. I... couldn't keep my care notes straight, or organize my visits like I normally do. They said my job was in danger. 

And... I just didn't go out much. I stopped going to my walking club. Didn't go to the art talks at the library anymore. I just... stayed home by myself.

Have you ever had experiences where you heard voices or believed that others were watching or interfering with you, even when you were not feeling unusually energetic, depressed, or emotionally high or low?

I... yes. I think we just went over this. 

But... yes. Like I said, after my energy dropped... and I was sleeping normally again... it didn't stop. The voices... and thinking people were tracking my work, judging me... that kept going for several weeks. 

I don't really know what else to say about it. It just kept happening.
Have the voices or the feeling that others were watching or judging you lasted for more than a month without stopping?

Yes... a lot longer than a month. 

I guess... it's been about nine months now. That they've been going on. The voices, and... worrying about my work. It just hasn't stopped.
